tabs.content:
// Ankommende Daten pro 5 Minuten in den letzten 3 Stunden, getrennt nach Quelle
union
    (energy_raw    | where ingestion_time() > ago(10h) | extend Source = endpoint),
    (frequency_raw | where ingestion_time() > ago(10h) | extend Source = "frequency")
| summarize Rows = count()
    by Source, Ingested = bin(datetime_utc_to_local(ingestion_time(), "Europe/Berlin"), 5m)
| order by Ingested desc, Source asc
tabs.title: Tab

tabs.content:
.show ingestion failures
| where FailedOn > ago(12h)
| project FailedOn, Table, Details, ErrorCode
| order by FailedOn desc

GridFrequency()
| where ts > ago(10h)
| summarize Seconds = count()
    by Hour = bin(datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin"), 1h)
| order by Hour asc
